On September 23, 2026, Knife River Corporation (the “Company”) posted presentation materials on the investor relations section of the Company’s website at https://investors.kniferiver.com/events-and-presentations. Company management may use all or a portion of these materials from time to time in meetings with or when making presentations to the investment community, current or potential stakeholders and others. The presentation materials are furnished herewith as Exhibit 99.1. In accordance with General Instructions B.2 of Form 8-K, the information furnished pursuant to this Item 7.01, including Exhibit 99.1, shall not be deemed “filed” for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “Exchange Act”), or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that section, nor shall such information be deemed incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange Act, except as shall be expressly set forth by specific reference in such a filing.
